## Session Brief

* [F1: proton runs with unequal beam energies](F1.md) - √s = 2√(E1E2); beam energies plumbed through ProtonIntegrand; build_frames at x_i·E_i with MadGraph's cm_rap; a unit test at unequal energies; equal beams bit-identical; docs fixed.

## Session Report

* [F1 report: proton runs with unequal beam energies](F1-report.md) - ProtonIntegrand takes both beam energies; √s = 2√(E1E2); build_frames puts partons at x_i·E_i and boosts by MadGraph's cm_rap; equal beams are bit-identical by construction and pinned; three new tests, six mutations caught.
* [V1 report: unequal beams, what moves and how it is checked against MadGraph](V1-report.md) - No banked cell can move: every validation card has equal beams. Two guards added (a proton beam below 0.938 GeV refused at parse; generate refuses an artifact at a stale √s), six mutations caught. Banking request for a 6500 × 4000 Drell-Yan σ row. MadGraph's massive √stot differs by 1.0e-9 at 6500 × 4000 and by nothing at equal beams, not the 2e-8 the brief quoted.
* [V2 report: the unequal-beam Drell-Yan row prepared for banking](V2-report.md) - The 6500 x 4000 card, the script entries, the planned manifest row, validate_hadronic reading the card's beams, the not-yet-banked paths in both gates and the collator, and the banking request. MadGraph was not run; the row's cells are planned.
